The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Administrative Commandant payable at Station Headquarters Balasore A/C .
